name: signature-trade-links
description: Signature Trade Links storefront, admin portal and backend API

scripts.emulators: sh backend/scripts/with-java21.sh firebase emulators:start --only firestore --project demo-signature $([ -f backend/.emulator-data/firebase-export-metadata.json ] && echo --import backend/.emulator-data) --export-on-exit backend/.emulator-data
scripts.test: sh backend/scripts/with-java21.sh firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-signature-test "node --test 'backend/test/*.test.js'"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only firestore,functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
